title: Remote devices
responsibility: Lists approved phones, granted projects and connection status with a revoke action.

inputs.name: RemoteDevices.devices
inputs.description: Required approved-device records with identities, names, project grants and connection information. Online means Connected; otherwise shows last-seen time or Not connected.

inputs.name: RemoteDevices.projects
inputs.description: Required identifier/name lookup for grants; absent projects say Project no longer listed.

inputs.name: RemoteDevices.store
inputs.description: Host store supplying busy state and revoke. A click passes the device identifier; busy disables the button.

outputs.name: RemoteDevices
outputs.description: Approved-phone list with project badges, permission summaries, connectivity and Revoke actions, or No phone is approved for an empty list. Revocation effects and errors are handled outside this list.
